Definition: from G1722 and G251; in the sea, i.e. marine:--thing in the sea.
BiblicalUsage: James says every kind of beast and bird and serpent and thing in the sea is tamed, and has been tamed of mankind, in James 3:7 — and then he turns to the one thing no man can tame, the tongue.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe James names the creatures of the sea to show how far our mastery reaches, so the failure to master our own tongue will sting all the more.
